t: An add-on board that gives a Raspberry Pi Pico a screen, buttons, and motor drivers.
steps: Find the board in the Pimoroni shop.
Buy a Raspberry Pi Pico and male headers.
Solder the headers onto the Pico.
Plug the Pico into the board.
Flash Pimoroni's custom MicroPython UF2 file.
Run an example that draws on the display.
Gather LEDs and jumper wires for circuits.
